checks.name: Bar selection opens direct tools without text editing
First chord click selects, next edits entire chord line
Variant chords are edited directly on the score and update live
Variant placement and rhythm are independent from base music
Variant settings contain only play pass and following passes
Sixteenth arrows keep toolbar under the measure
Rhythm has local controls and separate attack durations
Key and meter changes apply through local controls
Repeat and house cover contiguous selected measures
Section selection exposes its direct actions
Reuse count and instruction affect only that occurrence
Mobile direct measure tools fit without obsolete range menus
Mobile variants use score editing and compact pass-only popup
